references.text: Concerns the tithe of grain, wine, and oil that must be eaten before the Lord in the place he chooses, the same theme as in 12:17
Deals with the Levite not being forgotten, linked to regulations about tithes and gifts
Concerns the firstborn of cattle and sheep that must be eaten before the Lord, the same theme mentioned in 12:17
Describes the tithe given to the Levites, the basis for tithe regulations in Deuteronomy
Deals with the tithe of everything from the land, both from the produce of the soil and from the livestock, which is holy to the Lord
Concerns vows (נְדָרֶיךָ) to the Lord and that they must be fulfilled, directly linked to the vows mentioned in 12:17
Deals with freewill offerings (נְדָבָה), the same type of gifts mentioned in 12:17
Concerns the firstfruits and the firstborn that must be given to the Lord
Deals with the wave offering of the hand (תְּרוּמַת יָד) from the firstfruits brought to the place the Lord chooses
